text: 7.06 Rate of Drawback Normally drawback may be allowed as per All Industry Rate fixed by Do R in the Drawback Schedule where no CENVAT credit has been availed by supplier goods. However, an application in ANF-7A, along with documents prescribed in ANF-7A & Appendix-7E, may be made to RA or DC concerned, as the case may be, for fixation of brand rate where All Industry Rate of Drawback is not available or same is less than 4/5th of duties actually paid on raw materials or components used in the production or manufacture of the said goods.
